title: Tether launches self-custodial wallet with cloud backup option
summary: Tether launches tether.wallet, a self-custodial app supporting USDT, XAUT, USAT and Bitcoin with cloud-based key backup features.

title: XRP Ledger taps Boundless for bank-grade privacy on public blockchains

title: US Justice Department opens compensation for victims of $4B OneCoin crypto fraud
summary: OneCoin was launched by Ruja Ignatova and Karl Sebastian Greenwood in Bulgaria. Ignatova has been missing since 2017, and Greenwood was sentenced to 20 years in prison.
